death.place: San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy

summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandmother, of San Mango d'Aquino (an earlier Ferlaino-Fiorillo marriage, two generations before Leopoldo Ferlaino married Giuseppina Fiorillo).
bio: Tree: Giuseppina Ferlaino (1811-1877). Round 3 origins map gives her as 'b. c.1808'. Confirmed as mother of Domenico Fiorillo (b. 27 Dec 1840) in Nati 1840 act 79. Ferlaino is genuinely a San Mango family (229 entries in 1674-1804 stati delle anime).
sources: Antenati, San Mango d'Aquino, Nati 1840, act 79: https://antenati.cultura.gov.it/ark:/12657/an_ua37933123/LNZdd7O
openQuestions: Her parents (stati delle anime 1800/1804 may list her family)
Death act 1877 (San Mango Morti; Antenati coverage ends 1860)
